note: Landscape overhaul: the ground no longer renders as a two-tone checkerboard quilt. Town ground is worn grass and packed earth instead of beach sand, farm plots read as wheat, crops and tilled soil with plough rows, dirt lanes feather into the land and fade across fields instead of streaking through them, and rivers and lakes are smooth layered water with soft blended shorelines — no more giant navy checkerboard. Every surface now shades in smooth continuous tones that flow across tiles
